name: Indigo Fold
description: The product half-nested in the deep folds of heavyweight indigo-dyed linen, structural botanicals layered across it rather than beside it. Cool north-window light rakes the weave and dies into unfilled shadow — a dark, tactile still life.
lighting: Low cool north window, unfilled shadow
subject: product
prompt: a squat apothecary-style glass bottle with a black lacquer cap, the bottle is the hero of the frame and occupies roughly 60 percent of the frame height, tack-sharp and clearly lit and brighter than its surroundings, standing in the deep folds of heavyweight indigo-dyed linen with visible slub, weave irregularity and genuine crease memory, structural botanicals — thistle heads, a halved artichoke, eucalyptus sprigs — layered across the bottle rather than arranged beside it, a single cool north-window source from camera-left at a low angle raking across the linen's weave and dying into the folds, deep true shadow gathering in the fabric valleys with no fill light, one narrow shaft catching the bottle's shoulder, deep indigo and midnight blue with desaturated sage and silver-green botanicals, real fabric drape rather than smooth CGI cloth, no bright or saturated backdrop, no warm light, no second product, no visible vase or arrangement mechanics, immaculate still-life clarity
